caption:
He was under the sink when the phone rang. He couldn't answer.

CallTwin catches the call you can't take and sends you the job: name, number, address and what they need. Back to work, with the next job already waiting.

Scan the QR to get started, or go to hsw365.github.io/calltwin (link in bio).
